integrity: Direct elementary proof and exhaustive independent small-field checks; no independent external audit has been performed.
limitations: Counts linear ideals by dimension in the finite-field Lie algebra associated with an edge-distinctly-labeled complete bipartite graph. Does not determine integral/p-adic ideal zeta functions, group normal-subgroup counts in characteristic two, or arbitrary subalgebra zeta functions. The 3D Heisenberg case is standard.
title: Complete ideal-dimension polynomials for complete-bipartite graph Lie algebras
